name: dynamic-interview
description: Paced, multi-session interviews for understanding, planning, exploring, PoCs and debugging. Sets a goal and depth threshold up front, asks one question at a time with options and a recommended answer, delegates fact-finding, keeps a decision ledger across sessions, and shows live progress in a pane.

interviews_dir.title: Interviews folder (empty = ~/.claude/interviews)
interviews_dir.description: Folder for interview drafts (interview.json, ledger.md). The default sits outside your projects and survives plugin uninstall.

auto_allow_writes.title: Allow interview writes without asking
auto_allow_writes.description: Let Claude write interview files inside the interviews folder without a permission prompt each time. Your deny rules still apply.
